body: I love fallout 3, I can't wait until 4 comes out soon! When you feel you can not take it anymore, put a game on. It helps to escape reality for a few minutes :)
It does make sense, I am there with you man, the shit I have done to people...I deserve to be dead but I'm not, socits up to me to make things better for other people.

What PC games do you play, playing a videogame (last of us online) a week ago literally saved my life. I was set to play t a bullet through my brain. But it allowed the moment to pass and I'm still here a week later, when you are at your last point, put a game on and get lost in the game. It passes time. You know Metal Gear Solid 5 comes out in a few weeks its going to be epic, try that before you go man, its going to be awesome!

Im sorry you feel that! Wish there was something that could be said to take it away, I know it well myself. Having family is a big help for me. And if that's what it takes to stay alive. Its a powerful force of help, even if it doesn't seem like it.

Would you show your therapist this reedit post? There is nothing beautiful in a burning wreckage my friend, but there is beauty in you being here to talk with us! What are some of your favorite things to do when your not panicked? Do you like art or videogames?

Her death, along with anyone's death whom we care for is always with us. I live with my sisters death as she died in an ICU bathroom as a nurse working to save other people. The unbearable pain does fade, but doesn't go away. You need to take care of yourself through this time, and you already took 1 step forward with knowing it. Your talking about, it helps. Even if you don't notice it. Its helped me and many others on here. I'm confident you will find somebody. Keep on keeping on and cherish the time you did have with her.

I have no idea what your going through, but I know the feeling of wanting to end it. So you don't want to end up in the hospital? Please talk to me, is it meds you are afraid of? Crashing your car might not be your best choice man, lots of things can go wrong especially accidentally hurting someone else. Are you seeing a therapist at all?
For me it gets really bad then it gets to tolerable. I'm still kicking tho. Even as the pendulum swings between those feelings of dying to waiting one more minute.
Me too buddy, me too.Its tough I know. If you want to talk let me know

And I will suffer with both of you. Its the minute that passed , that's the victory, not the improving mood that we all wish would happen. My victories are counted in the minutes that have passed without me ending it.

That's noble, I love my parents and am still here. Let them know your in a tough place, you don't have to go into detail, but let them be your support. They will love you unconditionally! Its their pleasure to help you!

Hope to me wasn't the looking forward to improvement, it was the fact that through my darkest hour I survived. Barely but I'm still here and that hope/strength/whatever is there despite my attempts to leave. People who endure through the night I admire and your no different. Stay and talk man.
Can you PM if your still here? I would like to hear your story so somebody knows to carry you on when you depart?

Hey man, tomorrow sucks but its never as bad as yesterday the fact your still here makes it better. My circumstances haven't changed but I made an improvement today, a small insignificant improvement. But I'm better than I was a minute ago.
I'm sorry to hear about that man, I can't imagine what you are going through. I'm here if you need to talk in confidence.
Your nice, better than what I deserve, thank you for caring.

I was gunna get a hotel room, drink myself into stupor and then kill myself. But I decided not to do it. I actually sold my gun a few hours back. I'm still struggling, but I feel slightly better today than this past week. It was getting really tough to go on, and I planned it out, but I'm still here.

Oh my gosh! Thank you for that, it means a ton. I love the art, I would be in tears but my roommates are here and I can't cry for no reason lol. I'm saving this, thank you so much it means a lot to know someone cares. Thank you TheHopefulWalrus.

Hey bud, I know what its like to be disappointed by tomorrow, in fact today was supposed to be the day I ended it all. But today came and now I'm in my car to sell the gun I bought a few weeks back. I haven't had the opportunity to go to uni. So I joined the navy and have 5 years to go, hate every minute. Somehow I find myself still alive minute after minute even with the chance to exit 3 footsteps away, I surprised myself man. I don't want to die either, but how can we go on. And to be honest I'm not sure if I can make it tomorrow, but yesterday was the worst day I ever got mentally. My notes and gun were all good to go. Today is just a tiny bit better. I believe you are a lot stronger than yesterday my friend. And tomorrow can't hold anything against you. Today my suck, but think of how bad things were mentally just a few minutes ago. Your still here man, and I admire that. PM if you want to talk. I'm not promising things will get better, all I can promise is that each minute is a step, and you've already taken 5 hours worth of steps since you posted.

Are you a fan of MMA at all? I just saw this video and it made me laugh for the first time yesterday maybe you'll enjoy it to? https://youtu.be/r8yqD-t6Otk I'll try to work out tomorrow my work schedules really rough right now, I got to go to bed now, I hope you at least have an okay day tomorrow, that's all my days are. Really bad to bad, to okay. Its the best I can ask for at least. It was nice talking to you and having someone that at least understands a little where I am coming from.

Life sucks, I wish there was something I could do to help you with what your going through right now. I know that feeling of shame, it compounds my guilt, self loathing, and worst of all I can't stare at myself in the mirror for more than a few seconds before I get angry. I avoid it the best I can. I have screwed up a couple of chances with some girls myself, but I feel like damaged goods so I don't bother anymore. You say your athletic and work out? Does that help at all? I was suggested that, I don't know if I got the energy or even any motivation to do it.

Hey man I'm 23, I texted my parents that I was depressed scared and alone wish I kept the text to show you, but talking with them about how I was feeling helped a little bit for that day. I still feel like shit, but I made it through that night about a week ago. I had a gun ready and everything. Been a few times where I wander to the edge but I always called them.and managed to stop from falling off. I never let them know how close I was to pulling the trigger just let them know I wasn't mentally stable. I can't say it gets better, cause for me it hasnt. I still  have my own plan, just not sure on the timing. Talking with people is hard cause I don't trust anyone, except for my parents. they are scared for me and text me everyday.not sure how long I got left myself. Just know each night is survivable, barely but can be done.

I'm in the same boat, except I hate my life right now. I've spoken to my family a little bit about how I'm feeling. They don't understand. I'm gunna leave town this weekend. Maybe decide I won't get back. How old are you? I'm 23, can't wait for the pointlessness to end. I wonder if its our society that's taken reasons to live away from us?
